skill.name: writing-tests
skill.description: Guide backend test writing with concise cases, fixture-based setup, and reusable helper functions.
skill.summary: Helps teams write concise and maintainable backend tests.
skill.author: Crossbill-Highlights

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. The referenced line recommends test fixtures and helper functions, not system reconnaissance or unsafe host inspection.

static_findings.snippet: - When tests need setup, use fixtures and functions to avoid repeating same steps in multiple tests.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 discusses using fixtures and functions to reduce repeated test setup. It contains no instruction to inspect the host system or collect environment details.

content.value_statement: Backend tests can become long, duplicated, and hard to maintain. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward concise tests with reusable setup.
actual_capabilities: Encourages short backend test cases that focus on one behavior.
Recommends shared fixtures for common test data.
Promotes helper functions for repeated setup steps.
Supports maintainable test coverage through simple review guidance.
Applies to backend test writing and review prompts.
limitations: Does not define a specific testing framework or command.
Does not generate project-specific fixtures without repository context.
Does not replace domain knowledge for expected backend behavior.
Does not provide security testing methodology.

use_cases.title: Plan Backend Unit Tests
use_cases.description: Create concise test cases and shared setup before adding backend coverage.

use_cases.title: Review Test Maintainability
use_cases.description: Check whether new tests are short, readable, and free of repeated setup.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Testing Guidance
use_cases.description: Apply a simple test writing standard across backend pull requests.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one existing backend test.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this backend test. Suggest how to make it shorter and move repeated setup into fixtures or helpers.

prompt_templates.title: Design Test Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan maintainable tests for a backend change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design backend tests for this change. Keep each test focused and identify shared fixture data.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Repeated Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Reduce duplication across several test cases.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find repeated setup in these backend tests. Recommend fixtures and helper functions that preserve clear test intent.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Pull Request Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a backend pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this backend pull request for test quality. Flag long tests, duplicated setup, weak coverage, and unclear helper boundaries.

output_examples.input: A backend test suite repeats user creation in every test.
output_examples.output: Move shared user creation into a fixture. Keep each test focused on the behavior it verifies.

output_examples.input: A pull request adds one long integration test for several behaviors.
output_examples.output: Split the test by behavior. Use helper functions for setup and keep assertions close to each scenario.

output_examples.input: A team wants consistent backend test review guidance.
output_examples.output: Use short tests, common fixtures, and reusable setup helpers as review criteria for new backend coverage.

best_practices: Keep each backend test focused on one expected behavior.
Use fixtures for common test data and stable setup.
Create helper functions when setup steps repeat across tests.
anti_patterns: Writing long tests that verify several unrelated behaviors.
Copying the same setup steps into many test cases.
Hiding the tested behavior behind complex helper functions.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps write concise and maintainable backend tests with shared fixtures and reusable setup helpers.

faq.question: Does it require a specific test framework?
faq.answer: No. The guidance is framework-neutral and focuses on test structure and maintainability.

faq.question: Can it generate complete tests automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide test design, but complete tests require repository code and expected behavior.

faq.question: Is this useful for code review?
faq.answer: Yes. Reviewers can use it to identify long tests, repeated setup, and unclear coverage.

faq.question: Does it cover frontend tests?
faq.answer: No. The source guidance is specifically for backend testing.

faq.question: Can it improve existing test suites?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest fixture extraction, helper functions, and smaller test cases.
